scripts.preinstall: node -e "const u=process.env.npm_config_user_agent||''; if(u && !/^pnpm\//.test(u)) { console.error('Use pnpm instead of npm/yarn. Install: npm i -g pnpm'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.railway:build: BASE_PATH=/ pnpm --filter @workspace/grants-explorer run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build
scripts.dev: pnpm exec concurrently "pnpm run dev:api" "pnpm run dev:web"
